messages:
sam: Quick q for @lina and @ops-lead — we're updating security log retention/SIEM export design. Current hosted logs (auth/audit, infra metrics) kept 90d in S3. Compliance wants 1y for auth logs and 7y for billing-related events if legal hold. Thoughts?

lina: tagging this to RFC thread. Short answers: auth/audit = 1y default, billing = 7y if flagged. Need retention tiers in S3 + lifecycle + vaulting to Glacier. Also legal hold override.

ops-lead: +1. Also need RBAC for who can run SIEM exports. We should separate 'security-logs-read' from 'platform-logs-read'. No one outside sec + legal should request raw exports.

jordan: technical constraints — Splunk is our SIEM. Recommended flow: daily gzipped jsonlines exports to a KMS-encrypted S3 prefix, manifest file, then Splunk HEC pulls or we use Splunk S3 input. Use CMK with key policy restricting to splunk service account.

maria: note on PII/token redaction: redact tokens at ingestion. We can't export any logs containing full plaintext API tokens. Add redaction pipeline step or masking at source.

lina: suggested S3 layout:
```
security-logs/
  auth/
    yyyy=2024/mm=06/dd=01/part-0001.json.gz
  infra/
  billing/
manifests/YYYYMMDD-manifest.json
```
Include lifecycle rule: move to Glacier Deep Archive after 365 days (for billing move to GDA after 7 years). Keep delete blocked for legal-hold tag.

ops-lead: IAM snippet for Splunk service role:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow", "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"], "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-security-logs/*"]},
    {"Effect":"Allow", "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd"}
  ]
}
```
Keep the principal to the Splunk ingestion lambda/service only.

sam: How do we handle SIEM export for private deployments? Customers may want to ingest directly into their SIEM. Need guidance for KMS keys and cross-account access.

lina: For Private, recommend customers configure a customer-managed S3 bucket+CMK and add our exporter role with restricted AssumeRole + S3 write only to a prefix. Provide terraform module.

jordan: Also rate/size limits: batch size ~50MB gzipped, rotate hourly, avoid >1000 small files. Splunk S3 input has performance cliffs with many small objects.

maria: Security access controls: add RBAC matrix in console: who can request export, who can approve, and audit trail. Every export request should create a ticket+audit event.

ops-bot: Incident note created: INCIDENT-2024-453 export-policy-review — assigned to lina.

lina: I'll open RFC doc this afternoon and propose retention policies + IAM templates + redaction checklist. @sam can you add compliance requirements from legal?

sam: On it, will DM legal and post summary here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
